photos.c: New member Adam Jones competes in the National Junior League.

Above: It's winter again. The Under 17s are missing Matt Hillier in the County Champs but have a scoring four right at the front. Left to right are Gavin Mason (9), Toby Earle (1), Scott Walsh, and Adam Jones (6)

Right: A regular member of the Under 17 team last winter, Adam Jones has now moved up to the Junior ranks where he is making a niche for himself in the scoring ten in the Senior Belgrave team when it comes to the Surrey CC League. Adam earned himself a place in our National 12-Stage Relay in 1994 and placed 9th in the recent Surrey CC Junior Championships.

Above: Junior Captain Adam Jones was subjected to the time-honoured custom of being dunked in the water-jump (after being rugby tackled by Adam Daniel) when his team were victorious in four out of four National Junior League matches, thereby making absolutely certain of promotion.

The Belgrave Boys pose before the Winter's first Surrey League match at Wimbledon. Standing, left to right: Michael Manning and daughter, Ray Foley, Mick Graham, 'Gerry' Adams, John Mather, Rob Harding,Paul Roche, Junior Galley, a yawning John Gladwin who's seen it all before, Stu' Paton, Pete Gilbey, Tony Binda, Colin Preston, Roger Alsop, Charlie Dickinson, Marlon Anderson, Bruce Barton, Jesper Madsen, Alex Luce, Rex Bale, Steve Willimont, Tony Stone, Alan Mead, John Wasbrough. Kneeling: ?, Jim Estall, Markand Patel, Paul Graham, Peter McDonald, ?, Kevin Quinn, Amir Becirhodzic, Bernard Asante, Stephen 'Maggot' Quinn, John Wilson, Adam Jones.
